weapons.description:
Slightly rises into the air when using the Weapon Skill.
Performs a circular spin, dealing damage.

Fires a powerful sword beam towards enemies in front, with no hit limit.
The beam deals damage to enemies every 0.05 seconds and pushes them back.
100% chance to inflict Shock.

Dashes quickly forward, slashing enemies and inflicting stun damage three times.
Cooldown time: 3 seconds

Teleports to and attacks enemies while holding down the Weapon Skill.
Each hit with the Weapon Skill increases its Attack Speed by 15% (up to 75%). The range of enemy tracking widens according to the increased Attack Speed from the Weapon Skill.

Slightly rises into the air when using the Weapon Skill.
Performs a circular spin, dealing damage that causes bleeding to enemies six times.
Basic attacks gain an additional bleed chance (50%) and hit enemies three times.
Basic ATK Range +40%
ATK SPD -20%
Cooldown time: 1.5 seconds

Weapon Skill advances forward, attacking enemies.
Holding the Weapon Skill charges a gauge, increasing the number of attacks the longer it is held (up to 20 times).

While holding the Weapon Skill button, swiftly slashes enemies in front.
The Weapon Skill is affected by Attack Speed, and you can move while channeling it.

The skill can last for 2 seconds, and each hit with the skill extends the duration by 0.1 seconds (Per-monster internal cooldown: 1 second).

If the skill is used to the end, it delivers a Finishing Strike that deals critical damage proportional to the target's Shock stacks.
When the Finishing Strike damages an enemy, you are refunded Weapon Skill Cooldown equal to 0.1% of the target's Shock stacks.

Each time you defeat (100 / 200 / 300) enemies with Lightning damage, the weapon becomes Enhanced. Upon Enhancement, the following bonuses apply:

> Attack speed + (2.5 / 5 / 7.5)%
> Weapon-skill size + (10 / 15 / 20)%
> Weapon-skill count + (1 / 2 / 3)
> Weapon-skill cooldown (25 / 50 / 75)%
> Movement speed reduction while casting weapon skill (-15 / -10 / -5)%
Quickly move to and attack nearby enemies.

Performs a large spin kick that sends enemies flying and stuns them.
Cooldown time: 4 seconds

Roar loudly, dealing damage to nearby enemies.
Changes the basic attack range for 5 seconds.
Cooldown time: 1 second

Quickly move to nearby enemies and perform up to 7 tracking attacks.
After moving and attacking, if there are no more enemies to track nearby, the remaining tracking attempts decrease by 1.
(The same enemy cannot be tracked consecutively)
Cooldown time: 5 seconds

Slam the ground hard, launching enemies into the air and inflicting stun damage.
Plunging Attacks deal the same damage as Weapon Skills.
The range of Plunging Attacks increases by 100%.
Cooldown time: 4 seconds

Basic attacks hit enemies twice.
Quickly move forward, dealing damage to one enemy passed by for 2 seconds.
For every additional 10% Attack Speed, Weapon Skill hits +1 (up to 40 times).
For every additional 100% Attack Speed, Basic Attack hits +1.
Rush forward while rapidly spinning the scythe, dealing damage.

Harvest the souls of enemies, dealing damage. (Up to 400)

Size per stack +0.5% (Up to 100%)
Weapon Skill Attack Power per stack +0.8% (Up to 320%).
MOV SPD +7%
Basic Attacks have a 100% chance to inflict Poison.
Cooldown time: 2 seconds

Slam the ground hard, launching enemies in a wide area and dealing freezing damage.

ATK +10%

Spin at an extremely high speed, shredding enemies.

Basic Skills deal 50% additional damage to enemies.
When using the Weapon Skill, throw the returning Vulcanus forward, dealing damage as it travels back.

Cooldown time: 7 seconds

Becomes enhanced every 100 enemies killed (up to 3 times).

Charge forward quickly and become temporarily invincible.
If you deal damage to an enemy with the charge, throw an axe and activate the Red Dog (Character Passive).

[Basic Effects]
Equipped Poison skills become Drunken Skills, while synergy checks remain Poison.
Poison skills can be obtained even without the Melee tag.
When applying Poison, gain Drunkenness instead.
When the Weapon Skill hits, gain Drunkenness equal to the current Poison synergy level.
If you consume 5 Red Dog stacks within 5 sec., enter Hangover.

Poison damage increases are converted into Drunken Skill damage increases.

[Drunkenness]
When the Weapon Skill hits, forcibly triggers all equipped Drunken Skills.
On successful counter, decreases by 40; every 20m moved decreases it by 10.
3 sec. after last dealing damage, then every 1 sec., Drunkenness decreases by 5.
Max Drunkenness stacks are 100 and increase based on Poison synergy level.
For every 10 Drunkenness stacks:
- Move Speed +0.1%
- Attack Speed +0.2%
- Attack +0.1
- Drunken Skill damage +10%
At max Drunkenness, enter Full Drunk.

[Full Drunk]
For 7 sec., Drunkenness is fixed at max.
Drunkenness effects are applied at 2x.
Basic Skills gain Hit Count +3, Range +60%, damage amplified by 300%, and are affected by the Poison tag.
Fury and Red Dog stacks are fixed at max.
Drunken Skills cannot trigger, and Weapon Skill cooldown is restored to max.
When the duration ends, or after using the Weapon Skill, enter Hangover.

[Hangover]
For 3 sec.:
- Move Speed -50%
- Attack Speed -50%
- Basic Skill Range -30%
- Evasion +100%
Removes all Drunkenness.
Drunkenness cannot be gained.
Drunken Skills cannot trigger.
Weapon Skill cooldown is restored to max.
Using the Weapon Skill immediately removes Hangover.

[FLASH SLASH]
Can be charged until all Sword Gauge is consumed.
While charging, applies 20 stacks of Electric Shock per second to enemies within 5 range and consumes 10 Sword Gauge.
When released, unleash a lightning-type strike the pierces enemies, with damage increasing by 120% per second of charge time, and its area also expands.
Enemies that are hit consume half of their Electric Shock stacks.

[PASSIVE]
Status Effect Damage +7%.

[ACTIVE]
Killing a poisoned enemy grants 1 Blade Gauge.
+1 Blade Gauge per second per poisoned enemy (Maximum: +3).
If a Boss is poisoned, +3 Blade Gauge per second.

Skills and sheathing cannot be used while drawing the sword.
Poison Maximum Stakcs +200.
Attack Power -70%.

Upon Shealthing, casts Venom Rupture on poisoned enemies within 10 range.

[VENOM RUPTURE]
Consumes all poison stacks to trigger a powerful toxic exploision.
For each consumed stack, Damage and Size increase by the number of Toxin Synergy tiers.
(Basic Skill Damage × 10% Poison Stack × Toxin Synergy)

In Werewolf form, there is a 15% chance to inflict damage that causes Bleeding for 1 second to the enemy.
Defeating a Boss increases Damage Count by 1.
100% chance to inflict Bleed.

In Werewolf form, there is a 15% chance to apply a wound debuff to the enemy for 5 seconds, dealing damage.
Increase Base Damage by 30% when defeating a boss.
Increase Weapon Skill Damage by 5% against targets with the wound debuff. (Stackable)

In Werewolf form, inflict Frost Damage that applies the Freeze status effect to nearby enemies, and gain the [ Blessing of the Glacier ] and [ Absolute Zero ] buffs for 10 seconds.

[ Blessing of the Glacier ]
Movement Speed and Attack Speed are increased by 10% each, and the maximum stacks for Massacre and Frenzy are inccreased by 10.

[ Absolute Zero ]
The Freeze Chance of Basic Skills is increased by 30%, and Frost Damage is applied to Basic Skills. Basic Skill Damage increases by the current Freeze Chance.

In Werewolf form, dashes forward to deal damage to enemies in its path. Each time this Weapon Skill damages an enemy, gain a 'Slaughter' stack, and recover 5% of this Weapon Skill's cooldown (Stacks up to 10 times).

Basic Attack Damage: 100%

After 3 Basic Atacks, unleash a Strong Attack with +240% dmaage.

Basic Attack Damage: 100%

Enemies hit by the Magic Rabbit's Basic Attack have 1 card attached (Cooldown: 1s).
If an enemy with a card attached takes damage from Contract Summons or Summon Damage from Contract Summons or Summon-tagged skills, consume 1 card to deal an additional 10% damage.
When all attached cards are consumed, they explode and deal 275% Skill Damage.

Little Red Spirits deal 350% damage and then disappear.

While the Summoner is casting a Weapon Skill, fires Fireballs forward (Cooldown: 0.1s).

Basic: Throws 3 daggers that detect enemies within a 60-degree arc in front and carve a mark on them. If no enemies are present, throws them in a fan shape.

Enhanced: Throws 3 daggers that carve a mark on the 3 nearest enemies and immediately charges all dash counts.

Basic: Casts Unleash Blood, creating an Assassin's Mark with 2 durability on all hit enemies.

Enhanced: Casts Unleash Blood, creating an Assassin's Mark with 2 durability on all hit enemies.
Awakens the power of blood to amplify damage dealt by 3% for 3 seconds, (Max 5 stacks, duration resets upon activation)
Additionally, restores weapon skill cooldown by 0.2 seconds per current stack and immediately charges all dash counts.

Thrusts countless spears forward, dealing 30% damage per hit. Damage increases by 1% for every 10% Attack Speed.
After using a Weapon Skill, the first attack performs a massive thrust in three directions, dealing 70% damage per hit.

Thrusts countless spears forward, dealing 30% damage per hit.
Damage increases by 1% for every 10% Attack Speed.
After using a Weapon Skill, the first attack pulls in all nearby enemies and deals damage with 2x damage applied.

Thrusts countless spears forward to deal Fire Damage, then is slightly pushed back by the recoil.
After using a Weapon Skill, the first attack applies +30% Explosion Size, +50% Knockback Distance, and 2x Damage.

Deals Poison damage when attacking while in a Barrier state.

The first attack after using the Weapon Skill deals 300% damage and plants a 'Seed' in the target.

When a target with a 'Seed' is hit 10 times, the Seed explodes, applying the following effects:
1. Applies Poison stacks proportional to the current Poison Synergy level.
2. Activates one equipped Poison Skill.
3. Increases Poison Acceleration by 100 for 1 second after Seed explosion (Stackable).

'Seeds' can stack up to 10 times on a target.

Deals Bleed Damage when attacking while in a Barrier state.

When attacking in Barrier state or using Spin Attack, generates 3 independent hitboxes (Shaft/Axe Blade/Spear Tip) based on distance. Enemies in overlapping areas take stacked damage from all sources.

Inner zone deals 30% ddamage; Middle zone deals 90% damage and applies 2 Bleed stacks; Outer zone deals 60% damage and applies 1 Bleed stack.

The first attack after using the Weapon Skill slams the halberd down to deal Critical Damage.

While in Barrier state, spin your weapon to deal 200% damage to nearby enemies every 0.25 seconds. Hit enemies have a 15% chance to be inflicted with Stun.

Attack range and damage gradually increase based on spinning duration (+50% every 0.25 seconds, up to 3 seconds).

While attacking in Barrier state, slam your weapon down to deal Critical Damage. This attack immediately cancels Barrier and counts as the first attack.

Slam Damage scales with spinning duration, increasing from a base 100% up to 1000% (Maximum: 3 seconds).

Deals +100% damage to enemies that are Stunned or immune to being hit.

Throws a spear that deals damage 3 times to the enemy with the lowest health nearby.
If the key is held down after throwing the spear, it will execute the enemy hit by the spear.

Throws a harpoon that deals damage to the enemy with the lowest health nearby.
If the key is held down after throwing the harpoon, it will execute the enemy hit by the harpoon, pulling in all nearby enemies.
During Spinning Attack, pulls in all enemies hit.

Throws a lance that deals explosive damage to the enemy with the lowest health.
 If you hold down the key after throwing, it executes the enemy hit by the lance.
Fires a shot that deals explosive damage to enemies hit by the spinning attack.

Execution range increases by 25%, and plants a 'Seed' on enemies hit by Execution. Instead of a Spin Attack, casts Execution immediately when Stealth ends.

On Weapon Skill use, throws Mistilteinn at the enemy with the lowest HP, applying 1 Poison stack. If the Execution Gauge is available, casts Execution immediately.

If the thrown spear hits an enemy with a 'Seed', it detonates all Seeds to apply the following effects:
1. Applies Poison stacks proportional to the current Poison Synergy level.
2. Activates one equipped Poison Skill.
3. Triggers 'Poison Explosion' and recovers 50 Execution Gauge upon Seed detonation.

'Seeds' can stack up to 10 times on a target.

Poison Explosion consumes 10% of the target's Poison stacks to deal heavy damage.
Poison Explosion damage is affected by Poison duration, Poison synergy tier, number of stacks consumed, and currect Poison damage multiplier.

Throws a halberd that deals Bleed Daamge to the enemy with the lowest HP. Applies 7 Bleed stacks to the hit target and immediately casts Execution if this Execution Gauge is available.

On Execution or Spin Attack, generates 3 independent hitboxes (Shaft/Axe Blade/Spear Tip) based on distance. Enemies in overlapping areas take stacked damage from all sources.

Inner zone deals 30% ddamage; Middle zone deals 90% damage and applies 2 Bleed stacks; Outer zone deals 60% damage and applies 1 Bleed stack.

Hitting enemies with a Spinning Attack grants the [ Taoist Immortal ] buff (Cooldown: 3 seconds).
The [ Taoist Immortal ] buff stacks up to 5 times, lasts for 3 seconds, and its duration is refreshed upon gaining a stack.

[ Taoist Immortal ] Buff Effects (per stack):
- Spinning Attack Damage +10%
- Spinning Attack Range +10%
- Spinning Attack Multi-Hit Interval -10%
- Spinning Attack Stun Chance +3%
- Movement Speed +1%

When executing, Critical Damage is applied to targets with Stun or Hit Immunity.
(Cooldown: 1s - Taoist Immortal stacks X 0.1s)
The base damage of Spinning Attack is increased by 5X, while the base damage of Execution is reduced by half.

Throws a Golden Cudgel that deals Stun damage to the enemy with the lowest HP.
If the projectile hits and the Execution gauge is available, Execution is triggered immediately.

Rotate for 1 second and fire talismans at nearby enemies.

Fire bullets forward to create multiple graffitis, applying 3 Sorcery stacks to enemies within range, dealing damage every 0.2 seconds.
Cooldown time: 4 seconds

[WEAPON SKILL]

When Radiant Energy triggers Sorcery, the Weapon Skill Cooldown is reduced by 1%.
Fires 24 orbs of Radiant Energy forward over 2 seconds.

Consumes 2 charges at once to fire a single, amplified Enhancement Talisman.
Size of Enhancement Talisman +10% per additional Enhancement Talisman consumed The "Basic Skill Damage Increase" effect is applied to Enhancement Talisman at 150% effectiveness.
When an Enhancement Talisman triggers a Sorcery Mark, the weapon skill's cooldown is reduced by 5%.
Attack speed with Enhancement Talisman is reduced by 5%.
Enhancement Talisman is affected by Skill Damage Increase effects with the [Projectile], [Dark], and [Physical] tags.

The weapon skills of the Great Tree are not affected by tag effects that change position, direction, or speed.

Thrusts diagonally.

[ACTIVE]
Consume 1 Hellfire Dragon Communion to launch a massive sword beam forward. The sword beam pierces enemies and deals continuous multi-hit damage along its path.

[HELLFIRE DRAGON COMMUNION]
A weapon-exclusive stack that replaces normal Dragon Communion. It cannot be gained beyond its maximum and is not consumed in place of Hearts when taking damage.
Each stack held increases Flame Orb damage by 10%.

Strikes down with the scythe, dealing damage.

Creates an area that continuously emits occult energy by slashing space.

Consumes 6 Vampiric Gauge per cast (Maximum: 400).

Deals area damage to nearby enemies while charging.
When charging is complete, summons Longinus' Spear in front, dealing heavy damage.

+1% Longinus' Spear Size per 10 consumed Vampiric Gauge (Maximum: +400%).
+100% Longinus' Spear Damage per 10 consumed Vampiric Gauge.

Minimum Vampiric Gauge to charge: 50.
Consumes 50 Vampiric Gauge per charge (Maximum: 1000).
Recovers half a heart per 1000 Vampiric Gauge consumed during charging.

Super Armor is applied while charging during Blood Awakening (Passive).

Charges forward a long distance to inflict damage.
Hit enemies are knocked back and stunned for 2 seconds.

Upon use, cause a [ Flesh Explosion ] in the vicinity equal to your maximum hearts when hit.
(This is affected by damage nullification effects)

[ Flesh Explosion ]
Creates a Flesh Explosion around the character.
The Flesh Explosion inflicts 160% Poison attribute damage upon hitting an enemy.
The number of Flesh Explosions triggered is equal to half of your Max HP (rounded down for odd numbers).

Yandel roars, removing all status effects and gaining a Gigantification Buff for 15 seconds.

While the Gigantification Buff is active, the following effects are applied:
Character Size +12%

When reused while Shadowless Sword is active, slashes an enemy, and all Shadows will dash at the first enemy hit.

On use, activate Shadowless Sword for 5 seconds.
Can be reused while Shadowless Sword is active to trigger the Active Skill.

While Shadowless Sword is active, each time you hit an enemy with Shadowless Sword, Attack Speed increases by 15% (Maximum: 100%) (Resets when Shadowless Sword ends).

When reused while Shadowless Sword is active, slashes an enemy twice, and all Shadows will dash at the first enemy hit. When Shadows dash, they deal damage to the enemy twice.

When Maximus hits with a skill, gains [Judgment buff].

[Judgment Buff]
Increases Enhanced Attack damage and range by 10%. (Duration 5s, Max 5 stacks, Refreshable)

[Base Effect]
The dash preparation animation is removed, and input changes to Key-Down format.
Continuously dashes forward while holding the key, and direction can be changed.
Performs additional surrounding fire when casting dash or jump attacks.

[Enhanced Effect]
When casting enhanced dash or jump attacks, the attack interval decreases by 5% for every 10% of bonus Attack Speed, and decreases by 5% for every 5% of bonus Movement Speed.

[Additional Effect]
Every time Stigma explodes 5 times, Attack Speed increases by 5% and Movement Speed increases by 1.5%.
(Duration 5s, Max 10 stacks, Refreshable)

[PASSIVE]
When the Fighting Spirit Gauge reaches 1,000, an area lightning strike occurs at your current location.
While enhanced, Basic Attack hits deal Chain Lightning damage to up to 3 nearby enemies besides the original target. This damage is affected by the Chain tag.

[ACTIVE]
Throw an axe forward. The axe becomes fixed in place when it damages a boss or reaches a wall or the end of its range.
Picking up the axe directly reduces the remaining cooldown by 50%.
1 second after throwing it, use the Weapon Skill or dash again to leap to the axe's location and deal slam, Stun, and lightning strike damage.
The remaining axe is removed when the Weapon Skill cooldown ends or after 3 seconds.

[PASSIVE]
Basic Attacks become ranged musical-note projectiles that track enemies ahead.
When the Fighting Spirit Gauge reaches 1,000, a shockwave damages nearby enemies, and Basic Attacks are enhanced to fire one central note and two smaller notes.
After hitting an enemy, the central note bounces to nearby enemies 3 times by default and is affected by Chain effects.

[ACTIVE]
Slam the guitar into the ground, creating an elliptical shockwave that deals Stun damage to nearby enemies.
If you have any Note stacks, consume all of them and summon one amp for each stack consumed.
Gain 1 Note stack every 15 seconds and store up to 3 stacks. For every 100 current Fighting Spirit Gauge, the Note stack cooldown is reduced by 1%.

[AMP]
Whenever the player uses a Basic Skill, each placed amp recasts the same attack. When replicating a Basic Attack, an amp emits a shockwave around itself.
For each amp installed, the range of attacks recast by amps is increased by 5%.
Attacks recast by amps are treated as Weapon Skills, and their size and damage are increased by 25%. They can also trigger the Main Skill.
Up to 6 amps can be maintained, each lasting 30 seconds.
